nodes.label: FoldDiff: Folding in Point Cloud Diffusion (review)
FoldDiff
nodes.rationale: Instead of quantizing points into voxels/triplanes, uses FoldingNet's reconstruction order as a structured, permutation-invariant coordinate system so diffusion denoisers get a consistent vectorization; avoids cubic voxel cost and quantization error.

nodes.label: Global folding (Geometry Image + 2D UNet)
nodes.rationale: Whole object folded to HxW geometry image (16x16,32x16,64x32) via PointNet++ Set Abstraction; trained per category.

nodes.label: Locally folded tokens (DiT-fold)
nodes.rationale: Small point patches folded into kxk geometry images used as DiT tokens; shared lightweight FoldingNet reduces sequence length, giving compute linear in point count.

nodes.label: Permutation breaks denoising implicit prior
nodes.rationale: Unknown permutation means same index does not refer to same surface location, so residual != score.

nodes.label: Proposition 1 (identity permutation necessary)
nodes.rationale: Denoiser residual is proportional to score iff Pi=I; otherwise (I-Pi)x_hat term remains.

nodes.label: Denoiser residual-score relation (x_hat = y + sigma^2 grad log P(y))
Sinkhorn distance (entropic OT relaxation)
nodes.rationale: Entropy term makes discrete EMD matching differentiable; gave best generation 1-NNA even though EMD loss had lower reconstruction error.

nodes.label: EMD optimal transport formulation of folding
FoldDiff limitations (no texture, small DiT-S, no SE(3) equivariance)
Improved Video VAE for Latent Video Diffusion Model (review)
IV-VAE
nodes.rationale: Separates spatial (keyframe) and temporal (motion) compression, balances intra-group info exchange, and widens receptive field for high-res motion; fewer params (108M) than Causal VAE (127M) with better reconstruction at 4x8x8 FCR.

nodes.label: KTC (Keyframe-based Temporal Compression)
nodes.rationale: 2D branch compresses keyframe spatial content, 3D branch compresses group motion; each initialized from Z/2 image VAE, outputs C_out/2 channels, RMSNorm then channel concat; better init speeds 4x temporal compression learning.

nodes.label: GCConv (Group Causal Convolution)
nodes.rationale: Pads previous group features in front and zeros behind, regular conv inside group: keeps group-level causality while equalizing intra-group frame interaction to reduce flicker.

nodes.label: TMPE (Temporal Motion Perception Enhancement)
nodes.rationale: Parallel atrous convolutions + attention 2->7 applied after spatiotemporal compression to capture larger pixel displacement at high resolution while limiting cost.

nodes.label: RMSNorm replacing GroupNorm
nodes.rationale: GroupNorm may mix temporal statistics and leak future info; RMSNorm preserves temporal causality.

nodes.label: Channel reduction at spatial upsampling (-29% memory)
Cache-based long video reconstruction
nodes.rationale: 1-frame + 4-frame groups with cached previous-group state: memory 76.3G->14.1G with identical SSIM/PSNR to One-Step, unlike Overleap.

nodes.label: SetVAE: Hierarchical Composition for Set-Structured Data (review)
SetVAE
nodes.rationale: Hierarchical VAE for sets keeping exchangeability and variable cardinality: latent sizes m_l decoupled from n, coarse-to-fine via increasing bottleneck sizes.

nodes.label: Attentive Bottleneck Layer (ABL)
nodes.rationale: Projects set to m inducing points to form conditional prior; encoder h_enc adds residual posterior correction; output keeps n elements.

nodes.label: Mixture-of-Gaussians initial prior
nodes.rationale: Unimodal prior worsens FID 1047->1252; multimodal prior stabilizes attention learning.

nodes.label: Chamfer Distance reconstruction loss
nodes.rationale: O(n^2) proxy replacing O(n^3) optimal matching; trades exact matching for trainable cost.

nodes.label: SurVAE Flows: Surjections bridging VAEs and Flows (review)
SurVAE Flows
nodes.rationale: Unifies bijections, stochastic transformations and surjections by describing each layer with forward, inverse, likelihood contribution V and bound gap E; composable modules.

nodes.label: Likelihood contribution V(x,z) and bound gap E(x,z)
Name what an irreversible op loses and assign its probability
Variational Diffusion Models (VDM)
nodes.rationale: Rewrites diffusion VLB in SNR coordinates; continuous-time loss depends only on SNR endpoints, so learning schedule shape reduces estimator variance rather than changing objective.

nodes.label: Learned monotone noise schedule gamma_eta(t)
nodes.rationale: Monotonic network keeps SNR decreasing and loss weights nonnegative; learned schedule Var(BPD) 0.53 vs 31.6 beta-linear.

nodes.label: Variational lower bound (prior + reconstruction + diffusion loss)
Fourier features for fine-scale denoising
nodes.rationale: sin/cos(2^n pi z) channels let denoiser capture fine pixel value differences; effective only together with learned schedule, no gain for PixelCNN++.

nodes.label: DiffEdit: Diffusion-based Semantic Image Editing with Mask Guidance (review)
DiffEdit
nodes.rationale: Automatically infers edit mask from noise-prediction difference between query and reference text, uses DDIM encoding to preserve pose/appearance, and replaces outside-mask latents with encoded trajectory; no per-image finetuning.

nodes.label: Mask inference from conditional noise prediction difference
nodes.rationale: n=10 noise samples at strength 0.5, normalize, threshold 0.5; threshold 0.25 too wide, 0.75 too narrow.

nodes.label: DDIM encoding / inversion E_r
nodes.rationale: Deterministic trajectory preserves input info better than Gaussian noise addition; theoretical bound tighter than SDEdit when K2 small.

nodes.label: Propositions 1-3: SDEdit vs DDIM encoder distance bounds (Gronwall)
Optimal transport view of DDIM encoder
DiffEdit failure modes (flat background insertion, similar objects)
DiffusionCLIP: Text-Guided Diffusion Models for Robust Image Manipulation (review)
DiffusionCLIP
nodes.rationale: Fine-tunes diffusion noise predictor (not latent) with directional CLIP loss via deterministic DDIM inversion, avoiding GAN inversion information loss for out-of-domain poses/details.

nodes.label: Directional CLIP loss
nodes.rationale: Aligns image change direction with text change direction instead of absolute CLIP distance.

nodes.label: Multi-attribute transfer via noise combination
nodes.rationale: Weighted sum of noise predictions equals score of product of conditional distributions.

nodes.label: Drag Your Noise: Interactive Point-based Editing via Diffusion Semantic Propagation (review)
DragNoise
nodes.rationale: Optimizes U-Net bottleneck feature at a single timestep (t=35) instead of the noisy latent, shortening backprop and avoiding gradient vanishing/under-dragging; propagates optimized bottleneck to t'=10.

nodes.label: U-Net bottleneck feature optimization
nodes.rationale: Bottleneck carries stable high-level semantics (replacement MSE 0.03 vs 0.38 encoder block 1).

nodes.label: Diffusion semantic propagation (t=35 -> t'=10)
nodes.rationale: Copying bottleneck to later steps prevents forgetting; stopping at t'=10 lets refinement restore fine texture.

nodes.label: U-Net decoder 3rd layer features for supervision
DragNoise limitations (LoRA dependence, conflicting points, 3D rotation)
EDICT: Exact Diffusion Inversion via Coupled Transformations (review)
EDICT
nodes.rationale: Maintains two coupled latents updated alternately like affine coupling, giving algebraically exact inversion without DDIM's local linearization; no finetuning, ~2x DDIM compute.

nodes.label: Invertible intermediate mixing layer (p=0.93)
nodes.rationale: Coupling alone lets x,y diverge; weighted average contracts forward and dilates on inversion; small p amplifies float error.

nodes.label: DDIM inversion local linearization error
nodes.rationale: eps(x_t,t) ~ eps(x_{t-1},t) accumulates; amplified by CFG (conditional DDIM MSE 0.42-0.50).
